acceptance: After a runtime move lands and sessions restart, the primary _project/scripts venv contains only what uv.lock resolves (checked by `uv pip list` against the lock).
The chosen mechanism does not remove packages from a venv that a running tracker server is using, or the docs say when to run it.
description: Gap. Every tracker entry point runs `uv run --project _project/scripts --locked -- ...`, which installs what the lock needs but never removes extras. On 2026-11-12 the primary clone's _project/scripts/.venv still held todo_db 0.15.0 next to tractable 1.1.1, months of runtime moves after it was last needed. The venv therefore does not match uv.lock: a stale import of a retired package succeeds locally while failing in CI and in fresh worktrees, and checks that probe the installed runtime can pass for the wrong reason. Making entry points exact (`uv run --exact`, or an exact `uv sync` at a safe point) would fix it, but an exact sync removes packages from under running MCP servers, so it must happen at a point that does not break live sessions.
